# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `rephraseai` MCP server pointing at Rephrase AI's hosted HTTP endpoint (`https://www.rephraseai.com/cursor/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with Rephrase AI user login — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: remote URL supplied by the publisher; rephraseai.com was unreachable when the plugin was added.
